summary: Screen-fade controller: holds the current fade time between a start and an end bound and pushes the resulting alpha/brightness delta to the two UI-core screen faders every update.
evidence: Ui_ScreenFade_Setup (0x00368194) stores the display brightness (clamped to 0x9E, else 0xFF) at +0xC, the current value at +0x10, and 3.0f/6.0f bounds at +0x14/+0x18; Ui_ScreenFade_Update (0x0036830C) adds 0.0333f/frame, clamps into [f_14,f_18] and drives Ui_GetCore()->f_14 faders through vtable +0x44/+0x48. Class vtable 0x007654A8.

fields.name: maybe_brightnessLevel
fields.evidence: Setup: uVar5 = display->f_58 (or +0x64 when display flag bit 1 is set); uVar4 = (u8)uVar5 when below 0x9E else 0xFF; fade->f_c = uVar4 (byte store). Update treats 0xFF as 'no level' (auto fade). Only one writer/one reader, meaning inferred

fields.name: currentFade
fields.evidence: Update: in_s0 = fade->f_10 + 0x3D088889 (1/30 s step); clamped between f_14 and f_18 then stored back; Setup seeds it from func_001ED9FC() (in_s0) or f_14 - 1.0f when f_c == -1

fields.name: fadeStart
fields.evidence: Setup writes 0x40400000 (3.0f); Update clamps currentFade to >= f_14 and computes alpha from (current - f_14) * 3.3333f; lower bound of the fade range

fields.name: fadeEnd
fields.evidence: Setup writes 0x40C00000 (6.0f); Update clamps currentFade to <= f_18 and computes the second fader alpha from (current - (f_18 - 0.3f)) * 3.3333f; upper bound of the fade range

summary: Money/quantity spinner: a digit place (1..7), the amount and the unit price; each step adds/subtracts 10^(place-1), clamps amount + wallet to the 9,999,999 gold cap and refreshes the number panes.

fields.name: amount
fields.evidence: Step: self->f_58 += 10^(place-1) or -= it, kept >= 1, clamped so amount + wallet <= 9,999,999, then shown by Ui_SetNumberText

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.evidence: Step: uVar6 = self->f_5c * self->f_58; the product is clamped against the work+0x24AC0 cap - a per-unit price multiplied by the amount
